1CH 24:1.KJV: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
1CH 24:1.BHSA: וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקֹותָ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

1CH 24:2.KJV: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
1CH 24:2.BHSA: וַיָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַאֲבִיהוּא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

1CH 24:3.KJV: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
1CH 24:3.BHSA: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וְצָדֹוק֙ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן־בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

1CH 24:4.KJV: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
1CH 24:4.BHSA: וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי־אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם לִבְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־אָבֹות֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְלִבְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹותָ֖ם שְׁמֹונָֽה׃

1CH 24:5.KJV: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
1CH 24:5.BHSA: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגֹורָלֹ֖ות אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ ס

1CH 24:6.KJV: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
1CH 24:6.BHSA: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן־נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַסֹּופֵ֜ר מִן־הַלֵּוִ֗י לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָדֹ֣וק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָבֹ֔ות לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית־אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃ פ

1CH 24:7.KJV: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
1CH 24:7.BHSA: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגֹּורָ֤ל הָרִאשֹׁון֙ לִיהֹ֣ויָרִ֔יב לִֽידַעְיָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

1CH 24:8.KJV: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

1CH 24:9.KJV: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

1CH 24:10.KJV: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

1CH 24:11.KJV: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,

1CH 24:12.KJV: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
1CH 24:12.BHSA: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְיָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

1CH 24:13.KJV: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
1CH 24:13.BHSA: לְחֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

1CH 24:14.KJV: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
1CH 24:14.BHSA: לְבִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְאִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

1CH 24:15.KJV: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
1CH 24:15.BHSA: לְחֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמֹונָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

1CH 24:16.KJV: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

1CH 24:17.KJV: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
1CH 24:17.BHSA: לְיָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְגָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃

1CH 24:18.KJV: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
1CH 24:18.BHSA: לִדְלָיָ֨הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְמַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ פ

1CH 24:19.KJV: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
1CH 24:19.BHSA: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָבֹ֤וא לְבֵית־יְהוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔הוּ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ פ

1CH 24:20.KJV: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
1CH 24:20.BHSA: וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַנֹּותָרִ֑ים לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃

1CH 24:21.KJV: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

1CH 24:22.KJV: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

1CH 24:23.KJV: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
1CH 24:23.BHSA: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

1CH 24:24.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
1CH 24:24.BHSA: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שׁמור׃

1CH 24:25.KJV: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
1CH 24:25.BHSA: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃

1CH 24:26.KJV: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
1CH 24:26.BHSA: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֹֽו׃

1CH 24:27.KJV: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
1CH 24:27.BHSA: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנֹ֔ו וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃

1CH 24:28.KJV: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

1CH 24:29.KJV: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

1CH 24:30.KJV: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
1CH 24:30.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימֹ֑ות אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

1CH 24:31.KJV: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
1CH 24:31.BHSA: וַיַּפִּילוּ֩ גַם־הֵ֨ם גֹּורָלֹ֜ות לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִפְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְצָדֹ֣וק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָבֹ֔ות לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָבֹ֣ות הָרֹ֔אשׁ לְעֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥יו הַקָּטָֽן׃ ס
